changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'ProcessingStartedOn' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'api.Execution')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] ADD ProcessingStartedOn datetime null END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns WHERE Name = N'ProcessingStartedOn' AND Object_ID = Object_ID(N'api.Execution')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [api].[Execution] DROP COLUMN ProcessingStartedOn END

changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: UPDATE [api].[Execution] SET ProcessingStartedOn = StartedOn WHERE ProcessingStartedOn IS NULL
